channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Heated debate over California water plan as environmentalists warn of ‘ecosystem collapse’
item.description: California regulators will soon decide on a water plan for the Sacramento-San Joaquin River Delta. Environmental advocates warn that the proposal on the table will harm the ecosystem.

item.title: Farewell to Peter Duesberg, a godfather of scientific disinformation
item.description: Peter Duesberg squandered his scientific reputation by advancing a debunked theory about AIDS, but his influence on anti-vaccine activists lives on.

item.title: Silicon Valley is driving users to ditch keyboards and spend hours talking to their tech
item.description: People to ditch their keyboards for microphones.

item.title: UCLA medical school uses a 'systemically racist approach' to admissions, DOJ alleges
item.description: The Trump administration on Wednesday sought to join a federal lawsuit alleging that UCLA's David Geffen School of Medicine illegally considers race in admissions.

item.title: Alleged assassin for Mexican Mafia spent birthday stalking victim, detective testifies
item.description: Prosecutors have charged reputed members of the Eastside Paramount gang with the 2021 killing of Samuel 'Negro' Villalba, a member of the Mexican Mafia who had fallen out of favor with the syndicate after becoming homeless.

item.title: LAPD would delete nearly 12 million body camera videos under proposed policy change
item.description: The Los Angeles Police Commission tabled a vote on proposed changes to the department's data retention policy, expressing concern useful videos could be lost in a purge of old records.

item.title: Trump says he wants to get rid of 'the worst of the worst.' Start with Stephen Miller
item.description: Whatever changes occur, if any, in the wake of Minneapolis will mean nada if Stephen Miller remains in the White House, columnist Gustavo Arellano writes.

item.title: Climate change, electric vehicles and Delta tunnel among the focuses of gubernatorial candidate forum
item.description: The schism between Democratic environmental ideals and California voters’ anxiety about affordability, notably gas prices, were on full display during an environmental policy forum among some of the state’s top Democratic candidates for governor on Wednesday.

item.title: Why California's fight over ticket fraud has become a proxy war against Ticketmaster and Live Nation
item.description: Fake and speculative tickets pop up all over secondary market ticket sites, due to high demand and limited stock. In California, these kinds of ticket sales could be banned.
